topic.source_contract: Aerodrome safeguarding, obstacle limitation surfaces, instrument flight procedures, CNS, wildlife hazards and crane/temporary obstacle evidence

facts.IFP: separate assessment against current and possible future procedures
facts.guard: CAA no longer provides IFP safeguarding assessment service

facts.responsibility: aerodrome operator/licensee handles specific safeguarding consultations

facts.consultation: official maps can trigger consultation for height, wildlife and renewable-energy effects

scope_guards: A safeguarding-map location is not treated as an objection or clearance.
Planning permission is not treated as aerodrome, crane, IFP or CNS clearance.
Aerodrome operator responsibility is not transferred to the CAA.
Temporary construction equipment is not ignored because the permanent building is lower.
Official and unofficial safeguarding procedures are not conflated.
Wildlife, OLS, IFP and CNS assessments are kept separate.
No response or pre-application discussion is not treated as final acceptance.
No score or promotion is written without exact map criteria, dimensions, operator advice, technical assessments and as-built evidence.
